artworks.title: Un Monsieur qui veut se donner la satisfaction...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person applying a substance to another person's face. The image depicts a scene where an individual appears to be engaged in the process of molding or casting a face. The drawing is executed in a detailed style, capturing a sense of intensity and concentration in the character's expressions. The scene is cluttered with artistic elements such as drawings and masks on the walls, contributing to an atmosphere that evokes an artist's workshop or studio. There is a strong contrast between light and shadow, highlighting the central figures against the darker background.

artworks.title: Adieu, mon cher, je vais chez mes éditeurs...
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals. One is a woman in profile, with arms crossed, wearing a bonnet with a feather, a shawl, a full-length dress, a necklace, and looking into the distance. The other is a man sitting sideways at a table, holding a round object, with short hair, and wearing a dark jacket over trousers. There is a framed picture on the wall behind them, suggesting an interior setting with a wooden table cluttered with items.

artworks.title: Carotte du restaurant
artworks.description: The image depicts four men in a room. Three men are sitting around a table, while one man is standing leaning forward. The seated men have solemn expressions and are looking towards the standing man. They all have short, neatly combed hair and are wearing dark jackets. The standing man has slicked-back hair and is dressed in a dark top and light-colored trousers. Above them, two hats are hanging on the wall, and there is some simple molding near the ceiling. In the corner, a hook hangs below a small decorative element.

artworks.title: Oui, mon cher monsieur Badoulard, je vais...
artworks.description: The image shows two men seated in a side profile view. The man on the left sits with his hands together in his lap, while the man on the right reads a large book at a desk. A smoking pipe is on the table between them. In the background, two figures are partially visible, seemingly in conversation. The room features tall bookshelves filled with books.

artworks.title: Abonnés recevant leur journal...
artworks.description: Three people are engaged with newspapers in various positions. From left to right: one person stands, holding up a large newspaper titled "LA PRESSE." In the center, another person is seated on a cushioned sofa or chair, leaning back while holding a small device. To the right, a person lies on the floor, propped on elbows, examining a newspaper titled "DES DEBATS." The room has a couch covered in cushions and a framed artwork hanging on the wall.

artworks.title: Gibier qui peut être chassé en toutes les saisons
artworks.description: The image shows five men standing. The central figure is held by four surrounding men, two on each side. The central figure stands still with a slightly concerned expression, medium-length hair swept to the sides, wearing a waistcoat, a dark jacket, and trousers, with hands by his sides. The other men wear top hats and long coats, holding onto him firmly. One gestures with his right hand while holding the central figure with his left hand. The other men have expressions of focus or determination. The setting is a simple interior with a tiled floor and a textured wall. A fallen top hat lies on the ground in front of the group.

artworks.title: La Cour, vidant le délibéré...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a courtroom scene. The image depicts a gathering in a courtroom, featuring several seated individuals involved in legal proceedings. Two figures are sitting behind a desk, one of them writing or reviewing documents, while another is reading from a piece of paper. In the foreground, two individuals are seated in a defendent's area, facing towards the judges and clerks.

artworks.title: Et parlant a sa portière ainsi déclarée...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two well-dressed men in top hats interacting with an elderly woman at a doorway. One man is holding papers and seems to be speaking to the woman, who appears apprehensive. The doorway is subtly marked with the words "PARLES, CONGIE." The scene is monochromatic, using shades of black, white, and gray to emphasize the characters' expressions and clothing textures. The shading creates depth and emphasizes the tense atmosphere of the interaction.

artworks.title: Mr. le Juge de paix a rendu sa décision...
artworks.description: Three people are shown in the image. Two elderly women are in the foreground, depicted from the waist up. One woman is in profile, facing her companion with a gesture. The other woman has her hands clasped in front. Both women have gaunt faces and wear head coverings, one with a bonnet-like headscarf and the other with a fitted cap. They wear modest clothing typical of the 19th century. In the background, a man is seated. He wears a robe and a tall hat, typical of a judge. He is positioned behind a wooden desk or podium. There are other figures in the background wearing tall, cylindrical hats and dark clothing. The setting suggests a courtroom. The text header reads "Les Gens de Justice," translating to "The People of Justice."

artworks.title: Voila le ministère public qui vous dit des choses... désagréables...
artworks.description: The image shows three men from the waist up in a courtroom setting. The man on the left is seated and appears asleep with his head leaning forward. He has a round, clean-shaven face with long hair under his tall hat. His attire consists of a robe or coat with a white collar. The central man stands and leans towards the man on the right. He wears a flat cap, has a beard and spectacles, and is dressed similarly to the seated man. He places one hand on a table with documents and a folded cloth. The rightmost man leans over a railing towards the man in the hat with a tense expression. His hair is unkempt, and his attire looks less formal. The background shows a crowd of indistinct faces, focusing on the three men in the foreground.

artworks.title: Il défend l'orphelin et la veuve, a moins...
artworks.description: Three figures are depicted from the waist up. The central figure is standing with arms outstretched and palms facing forward, gesturing dramatically. This person has curly hair and an expressive face with raised eyebrows and an open mouth. They are wearing a checkered robe with a white necktie. To the left, a seated figure with a shrouded head and downcast eyes is visible, dressed in a dark, loose garment. To the right, a small child sits, apparently holding or biting a finger, with short hair and a dark outfit. The background shows plain walls with a checkered or lined pattern, and a top hat is placed on a nearby surface, adding to the setting.

artworks.title: Au Café d'Aguesseau
artworks.description: The image shows two men seated at a dining table. The man on the left is sitting upright, facing forward with short, curly hair, dressed in dark formal attire with a white shirt and a dark cravat. The man on the right is slightly hunched over while seated, older looking, with lines on his face and sparse hair. He wears a long dark cloak. The table is set with a white tablecloth, a bottle of wine, a decanter, and plates with food including a cut of meat. In the background, there is another individual standing next to a wall with ornate architectural detailing.

artworks.title: Un Défenseur... causant... dans son cabinet habituel
artworks.description: The image shows two men standing facing each other. The man on the left is wearing a tall top hat and glasses, holding two glasses in front of a counter. The man on the right is wearing a wide-brimmed hat and a cape-like garment over a shirt. The background features a wall with vertical lines and a framed panel.

artworks.title: Nous avons grande représentation aujourd'hui
artworks.description: The image depicts two men from the waist up. The man on the left faces right, while the man on the right faces left. The man on the left wears a dark robe and has thinning hair. The man on the right holds a pastry and a feather duster. The background shows an interior setting with a suggestion of courtroom seating or barriers. The image is in a simple, sketch-like style with a French caption below.

artworks.title: Encore perdu en Cour Royale... et il se lamente...
artworks.description: The image depicts four men standing closely together. They have distinct facial features with exaggerated noses and somber expressions. Two men have white hair and one has dark hair. They are wearing long, dark robes and tall hats. The men have different facing directions, with one facing away and the others turned towards one another. The man on the far right appears to be slouching with his hands tucked into his coat. The background is minimal. No jewelry or objects are visible.

artworks.title: Vous avez perdu votre procès c'est vrai...
artworks.description: The image shows two men depicted in full-body view. The taller man stands upright with a demeanor of confidence, while the smaller man is clutching his robe and appears to be leaning back slightly. The taller man has plump facial features and a slight smile, dark hair styled beneath a cap. He is wearing a long black robe with wide sleeves and a white cravat at the neck. The shorter man is wearing a cap and a matching black outfit that consists of a coat and trousers. The backdrop has a textured wall and what appears to be a door to the left side. The image is in a monochromatic style with shading for depth. The border features handwritten text and the artist's initials "L.D." at the bottom.

artworks.title: Ton habit me convient, je te l'emprunte...
artworks.description: The image shows two men standing side by side facing a wall with their backs to the viewer. The man on the left has a bald head and is leaning slightly forward with his hands resting on a piece of furniture in front of him. He wears a light-colored shirt, dark pants, and shoes. The man on the right has dark, short hair and is standing upright with one arm bent at the elbow, holding the edge of his torn tailcoat. He wears a dark suit and shoes. The room contains several sculptures on a mantel or shelf, a large framed picture on the wall, a patterned carpet, and appears to be luxuriously decorated.

artworks.title: Un Ami est un crocrodile...
artworks.description: The image shows four figures in an indoor setting. Three people are seated around a small dining table, and one person is standing. The seated individuals include a man on the left, who is shown in profile, wearing a tall hat and formal attire with long sleeves. Next to him is a child, partially turned towards the man, wearing a simple garment. Across from these two is another seated figure, turned away from the viewer, wearing what seems to be a striped garment with a bonnet or head covering. The standing figure on the right side of the image is an older person with a round face and short hair; they are dressed in a long dark coat and appear to be holding a small jug or pitcher in their right hand. The background shows a textured wall and a framed picture above the seated group, while the floor beneath them is lightly shaded.

artworks.title: Mon cher je t'assure que je te...
artworks.description: Two men are depicted in the image, shown from head to toe. The man on the left is standing with his hands clasped in front of him. He is wearing a dark suit with a bow tie and a white shirt. The man on the right is also standing with his hands in his pockets. He is wearing a white shirt with a patterned robe draped over his shoulders and striped trousers. There is a large framed painting behind them, along with heavy curtains and a portion of an upholstered chair.

artworks.title: Est-ce que votre mari serait jaloux...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures. The central figure is well-dressed in a dark coat and top hat and appears to be interacting with the figure to their right, who is wearing a headscarf and an apron. To the left is another figure holding a stick, dressed in lighter, worn clothing. All the figures are in monochrome, suggesting graphite or ink. The expressions and interactions hint at a narrative, with the central figure engaging the attention of the person with the headscarf, while the figure holding the stick looks on. The background is loosely sketched with foliage and hints of a structure.

artworks.title: Comment!... tous mes moutons sont morts...
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals. An older man stands facing a woman, with his full body visible. He wears a tall black hat, glasses, a dark suit with a vest, and white shirt, holding his hands on his hips. The woman stands to his left, facing him with her back to the viewer, visible from head to toe. She wears a bonnet and a long dress with an apron tied around her waist. The third person is a child, visible from the back, wearing a long coat and a flat hat, standing to the man's right. The background features a domestic setting, including a hanging pan and a large jug on a table to the left, and a cupboard or a door with items on top to the right. The scene is rendered in shades of gray, giving it a sketched appearance.

artworks.title: Comment trouvez-vous ce petit vin-la...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring a large barrel, various instruments, and four individuals. Two figures are peering over the top of the large barrel, while two others stand alongside each other, one holding a glass near the pipe. To the side, a person is bent over, gathering something in a bag. The style is reminiscent of 19th-century satirical illustrations with exaggerated features and humorous expressions, capturing a vintage industrial or winemaking setting with a whimsical touch.

artworks.title: Dis donc ma femme... je ne vois rien!
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man using a telescope. The scene features a man standing on an elevated surface looking through a telescope, while two other figures are positioned in the lower left. The background shows a landscape with fields and hills. The style is characterized by fine lines and shading with black and white tones.

artworks.title: Ah! Gringalet d'Paris... tu viendras faire danser...
artworks.description: This image shows a group of elegantly dressed people in a public setting. The individuals are wearing 19th-century attire, including top hats, long coats, bonnets, and dresses. Some are engaged in conversations. In the background, there is a podium with two figures; one is playing a flute, while the other is writing or sketching. The scene appears to be outdoors, possibly in a park or street, with a tree visible on the left. The drawing technique uses various shades to depict details and depth, with a focus on facial expressions and clothing textures. The lack of vibrant colors accentuates the contrasts and social interaction theme.
